draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.34, the 50th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 4th of 14 at QB. He went 33rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Jay Cutler. Testing standouts: broad jump (90th percentile). College production: 2,406 passing yards in 2022, 14th of 14 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the New York Jets (practice squad). 21 career games and 21 starts over 2 completed seasons. Still developing: 5 AV in 2024. Weak spots: epa per dropback -0.19 (12th percentile), approximate value 5 (16th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 quarterback who played: 2,091 passing yards against a median of 1,765, above the norm.
